reason: A local-first DeepSeek Harness plugin for persistent agent memory, bounded session context injection, Chinese BM25 recall, read-only governance, trajectory review, and confirmation-gated local writes.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于本地 Markdown 的持久化智能体记忆、按需中文检索、会话上下文注入和需确认的事务写入能力。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with persistent agent memory in local Markdown, on-demand Chinese retrieval, bounded session context injection, and confirmation-gated transactional writes.

capabilities: Reads local Markdown memory, project notes, and session-related evidence
Performs local exact and Chinese BM25 memory recall
Injects a bounded memory context package into new agent sessions
Writes local memory files through a confirmation-gated transactional workflow
Registers memory-related tools and session hooks with DeepSeek Harness
